But we've still got to
settle this properly.
I know.
We absolutely have to
make them stop...!
I know...
We absolutely have to
make them stop...!
...!
Where are you going,
Azlier?
Where are you going,
Azlier?
I have no need
to answer you!
I'm afraid that
will not do.
We cannot allow
you to commit
any more acts of violence!
We can't simply
say, 'Very well,'
and accept that.
Letting you carry on
doing whatever you please
is becoming a nuisance...
What are you talking about?
Don't play dumb!
There's no use
trying to hide it.
Don't play dumb!
We know
everything.
Were you the ones
going around setting fires
near the settlements?
Were you the ones
going around setting fires
near the settlements?
...!
Hmph!
Looks like we hit the mark
and left you speechless!
Silence, little girl!
Stop, Galeor.
But...!
Clear the way.
We are in a hurry.
We have no time
to discuss such nonsense
with you.
N-nonsense,
you say!?
Wh...!?
N-nonsense,
is it!?
Wh...!?
Now, get out
of the way!
What should I do?
 Let them pass.
 Refuse.
Until I get
a proper answer,
I can't move aside.
Until I get
a proper answer,
I can't move aside.
...
Heh. So in the end,
that's your answer.
If you won't move,
we'll move you by force...
That's all there is to it!
...
Teacher!?
Take responsibility for your actions.
Never cover them up
or run away.
Someone used to say that...
